title: NB_3 Lead Optimization Pipeline — Full Specification

workflow.title: Replicate ipTM stability (5 diffusion seeds)
workflow.gate_criterion: Median ipTM ≥0.60 to proceed; <0.50 kills lead
workflow.command_summary: boltz predict (×5 seeds) → extract ipTM distribution
workflow.fail_condition: All replicates <0.55 → binding mode inherently weak

workflow.title: Interface refinement + MPNN redesign (10–15 variants)
workflow.gate_criterion: ≥1 design at ipTM >0.68 to proceed; <0.65 max kills optimization
workflow.fail_condition: Max ipTM plateaus <0.65 → interface optimization saturated

workflow.title: Hotspot steering (constraint-biased diffusion, 5–10 variants)
workflow.gate_criterion: ≥1 design at ipTM >0.68 AND ≥2 hotspots to proceed
workflow.fail_condition: ipTM <0.65 AND no hotspot shift → binding mode locked in wrong orientation

workflow.title: Focused scale-up (100–200 seeded backbones)
workflow.gate_criterion: Only run if Step 3 ipTM ≥0.68 OR Step 2 reached 0.70
workflow.command_summary: Partial-diffusion batch → MPNN → Boltz tier-1/2/3 validation
workflow.fail_condition: Cost overruns without further ipTM gain; stop if max <0.65

key_principles: Honest reporting — report full distributions, not cherrypicked values
Early stopping — kill leads that plateau, don't chase sunk costs
Contact residue verification — always map predictions back to DENV1–4 alignment before final ranking
